rules.title: LARSO security deposit interest
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized units in the City of Los Angeles must pay tenants accrued interest on security deposits, either monthly or yearly, as a direct payment or a rent credit. The landlord must tell the tenant in writing which method it chose.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios de unidades sujetas a estabilización de rentas en la Ciudad de Los Ángeles deben pagar a los inquilinos los intereses acumulados del depósito de seguridad, mensual o anualmente, como pago directo o crédito en la renta. El propietario debe notificar por escrito al inquilino el método elegido.
rules.quoted_span: A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant’s rent.
rules.effective_date_quote: Interest shall begin accruing on November 1, 1990, on a monthly basis.
rules.coverage_conditions: Properties subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LARSO).
rules.key_value: Interest rate set annually by the City; 4.320% for calendar year 2025
rules.caveat: Secondary source (landlord association article posted May 2025); the interest rate is set annually and the 2026 rate is not shown.
rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be used as a defense in eviction proceedings.
